sloka: विरराज अथ तद् वेश्म रश्मिमान् इव रश्मिभिः ।जाम्बू नदमयानि एव शयनानि आसनानि च ॥५-६-४१॥
transliteration: virarāja atha tad veśma raśmimān iva raśmibhiḥ ।jāmbū nadamayāni eva śayanāni āsanāni ca ॥5-6-41॥

translations.english: The leader of the vanaras saw there beds, seats and main vessels made of gold.
